caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, rust-colored metal box with a hinged lid. The surface of the box displays various shades of brown and dark reddish-brown, giving it a mottled and slightly worn appearance. On the top of the lid, there is a raised or embossed design of a bird, specifically an eagle, holding arrows and an olive branch in its talons. The box is placed on a plain background with a light beige hue. In the bottom left corner of the drawing, the name "John. H. Tercuzzi." is written in capital letters. The overall composition centers on the box, which is presented at an angle so that its top, front, and side are all visible.
title: Match Box
